gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The programme aims at the ___ (EDUCATE) of young farmers.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.

gaps.explanation: 'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.
